pages.quiz:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'My name is Njeri.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Au revoir, Monsieur.
   B. Et toi ?
   C. Ça s'écrit comment ?
   D. Je m'appelle Njeri.

2. What does 'non' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. goodbye
   B. thank you
   C. no
   D. hello, good day

3. What does 'le bébé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the child
   B. the mother
   C. the boy
   D. the baby

4. What does 'la mère' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the grandmother
   B. the mother
   C. the grandfather
   D. the sister

5. What does 'sur' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. in
   B. on
   C. under
   D. between

6. How do you say 'It is a table.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.
   B. Où est le chat ?
   C. C'est une table.
   D. Le livre est sur la table.

7. What does 'le sac' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the kitchen
   B. the ball
   C. the bag
   D. the sofa

8. What does 'la cuisine' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the bathroom
   B. the kitchen
   C. the door
   D. the living room

9. What does 'je joue' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. I dance
   B. I play
   C. I rest
   D. today

10. What does 'hier' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tomorrow
   B. yesterday
   C. I rest
   D. I dance

11. What number is 'sept' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 25
   C. 8
   D. 14

12. Which month is 'mars'? (1 mark)
   A. December
   B. June
   C. March
   D. July

13. How do you say 'I drink a juice.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est un gâteau.
   B. Je bois un jus.
   C. C'est bon pour la santé.
   D. Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.

14. What does 'les haricots' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. vegetables
   B. beans
   C. the orange
   D. maize

15. What does 'le dos' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the eyes
   B. the back
   C. the hand
   D. the foot

16. What does 'grand' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. short
   B. tall, big
   C. black
   D. long

17. Fill in: Il y a ______ nuages. (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. une
   C. des
   D. un

18. What does 'le vent' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the sun
   B. the cloud
   C. the weather
   D. the wind

19. How do you say 'Turn right.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Elle est sous la chaise.
   B. Où est la clé ?
   C. Le frigo est dans la cuisine.
   D. Tournez à droite.

20. How do you say 'Excuse me, where is the school?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Tournez à gauche.
   B. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   C. Elle est sous la chaise.
   D. Où est la clé ?

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain how to stay safe in harsh weather such as a storm. (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Explain why managing time is important and say how you use your Saturday. (3 marks) (3 marks)

23. Write the French letter names for the name Kamau. (3 marks) (3 marks)

24. Write the numbers from 11 to 15 in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. List four rooms in a house in French. (4 marks) (4 marks)

26. Write three weather sentences in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

27. Write three sentences in French with J'ai and a number about your body. (3 marks) (3 marks)

28. Write the three direction words for straight, left and right in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

29. List the members of a nuclear family in French with le or la. Give at least five. (5 marks) (5 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Je m'appelle Njeri.
   My name is Njeri. in French is Je m'appelle Njeri.

2. C — no
   non means no.

3. D — the baby
   le bébé means the baby.

4. B — the mother
   la mère means the mother.

5. B — on
   sur means on.

6. C — C'est une table.
   It is a table. in French is C'est une table.

7. C — the bag
   le sac means the bag.

8. B — the kitchen
   la cuisine means the kitchen.

9. B — I play
   je joue means I play.

10. B — yesterday
   hier means yesterday.

11. A — 7
   sept means 7.

12. C — March
   mars means March.

13. B — Je bois un jus.
   I drink a juice. in French is Je bois un jus.

14. B — beans
   les haricots means beans.

15. B — the back
   le dos means the back.

16. B — tall, big
   grand means tall, big.

17. C — des
   Des is used for many things.

18. D — the wind
   le vent means the wind.

19. D — Tournez à droite.
   Turn right. in French is Tournez à droite.

20. B — Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   Excuse me, where is the school? in French is Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stay inside a strong building, stay away from tall trees and water, and listen to adults.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each safety point.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Managing time helps us finish work and rest. On Saturday, I help at home and play.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for importance and 2 marks for a correct example.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: ka, ah, em, ah, ü
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for all five correct; lose 1 mark for every two mistakes.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: onze, douze, treize, quatorze, quinze
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for all correct; lose 1 mark for every two errors.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: la chambre, le salon, la cuisine, la salle de bain
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct room with le or la.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Il fait beau. Il pleut. Il y a du vent.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: J'ai deux mains. J'ai dix doigts. J'ai deux pieds.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: tout droit, à gauche, à droite
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

29. (5 marks)
   Answer: le père, la mère, le frère, la sœur, le bébé (also l'enfant, le grand-père, la grand-mère)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its le or la.
